id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

userId.description: Reference to the user in the authentication system. This is the Firebase UID.

startingCapital.description: The user's initial capital available for investment.

riskTolerance.description: The user's risk tolerance (low, medium, high).

ChatThread.title: ChatThread
ChatThread.description: Represents a single chat conversation thread.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChatThread entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owns the thread.

name.description: The name or title of the chat thread.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the thread was created.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last message in the thread.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single chat message within a thread.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChatMessage entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who sent the message.

threadId.description: Reference to the ChatThread this message belongs to.

role.description: Indicates who sent the message (user or assistant).

content.description: The text content of the message.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. The 'userId' and 'profileId' parameters are the Firebase UID. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase UID of the user.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The Firebase UID of the user, used as the document ID.

definition.description: Stores metadata for each chat thread belonging to a user.
Stores chat messages for a specific thread. The 'userId' parameter is the Firebase UID.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase UID of the user.

params.name: threadId
params.description: The unique identifier for the chat thread.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique identifier for the chat message.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed for a multi-threaded chat application. It ensures security and scalability by nesting `threads` and `messages` under the user's ID. User profiles are stored separately. This path-based ownership simplifies security rules, adhering to principles of Authorization Independence and Clarity of Intent.
